scene: You climb the roof hatch onto an airy pavilion transit terrace.
picture: A flat rooftop terrace along one level floor. On the far left, a yellow rickshaw waits with a driver. Left of centre stands the player in blue cap and orange cardigan holding his cane. At centre sits a hand-cranked track trolley. To the right, a canal water taxi floats at a small platform gate.
shown: a wheeled rickshaw with a smiling runner waiting on the far left
a hand-cranked rail trolley on narrow tracks at the centre
a low wooden water taxi tied to an open canal gate right
